name: Boldfit Sneakers for Men DripBloc
description: Boldfit DripBloc men's sneakers with a premium synthetic leather upper, soft suede accents, Lycra lining, lightweight TRP sole and rubber outsole. Designed for casual wear, daily commutes and light activity.

positive_points: Good fit reported by some customers
Good material quality reported by some customers
Some buyers received an extra pair of soles and a shoe pouch
negative_points: Some customers reported poor stitching durability
Some customers found the shoes heavier than expected
One review reported sole noise on marble flooring
review_summary.ai_summary: Overall customer feedback is moderately positive at 3.9/5. Buyers frequently mention stylish looks, comfort, fit and value for money. However, there are complaints about stitching durability, packaging, color differences, weight and comfort from some variants.

reviews.title: Boldfit stylist and comfort.
reviews.comment: Looks fantastic and impressive. Material and quality are excellent. Very comfortable and fits perfectly. Great value for money.

reviews.title: Value for money, Comfortable, best for daily use
reviews.comment: Awesome, value for money and top-notch comfort. Best for daily use. Customer also mentioned receiving an extra pair of shoe soles and a pouch.

reviews.title: Nice shoes
reviews.comment: Shoe feels ventilated while driving. Looks and feels good. Quality and stitching is good but not great. Shoes are a bit heavy. Sole makes a weird noise while walking on marble.

reviews.title: Bad Quality
reviews.comment: Quality of product is not good. After wearing the shoe for 3 hours, its stitching came apart. Shoe looks good, but quality was reported as very bad.

reviews.title: Packaging
reviews.comment: Customer complained about poor packaging but said the product itself was good, fit nicely and had good material. Customer also mentioned the color was slightly different.

reviews.title: Not comfortable
reviews.comment: Customer reported that the shoes were not very comfortable.

reviews.title: Amazing product for sneakers lovers
reviews.comment: Excellent material quality, comfortable fit and great value for money.

reviews.title: Budget friendly
reviews.comment: Pretty good compared to the price.
